summary: No errors found in the four requested estimates. Read the complete supplied markdown conversion, including endnotes, references, and the correction notice. Checked every cited PDF page (9, 10, and 14), recovered Table 2 with PyMuPDF, and checked design and scope on PDF pp. 8 and 11-13. Table 2 confirms textual versus visual Model (1a): coefficient 0.29, SE 0.11, p≤0.01; Model (1b): coefficient 0.23, SE 0.10, p≤0.05; visual versus control Model (1a): coefficient 0.13, SE 0.10, with no numerical p-value; Model (1b): coefficient 0.17, SE 0.10, p≤0.10. Section 4.3.1 establishes these contrasts. The 428 observations are refinements in the full three-arm regressions, as stated in Table 2 and endnote 5. The two-arm participant counts are not printed and correctly remain null. The script flag for control_mean=-0.06 is a false positive: PDF p. 14 (printed p. 13), endnote 6 explicitly says "0.06 SDs below the mean (i.e., the 51st percentile)." Below the standardized mean supplies the negative sign; this is transcription of the reported direction, not a derived statistic. The same endnote prints the textual prediction of 0.23 SDs above the mean and the approximate 18% increase. These are correctly identified as simulated adjusted predictions and a percentage increase in percentile ranks. The internally inconsistent 51st-percentile wording belongs to the paper and is already disclosed in the extraction. The requested outcome, timing, arm, and design codes are supported. The observation unit is output, while se_basis=participant and regression.se_type=clustered_participant are supported by Section 5 describing clustered robust errors for ideator differences and dependence among successive refinements of the same idea, together with Figure 3 stating that each participant provided one idea. The software cluster-variable name is not printed. No additional eligible outcome or full-sample contrast was found in the supplied article: the textual-versus-control contrast is already represented, and the remaining reported results are moderation, baseline checks, effort, validation correlations, or comparisons with a separate sample lacking established randomized assignment. The separate Online Appendix A-E is absent from the supplied PDF and available local supplement records. Fresh urllib requests to the named DOI and St. Gallen sources, using User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1, both failed with WinError 10013. Completeness beyond the supplied article therefore remains unverified; no missing estimate is asserted without evidence.
